auditMetadata.mission: VEIL — FINAL RED TEAM: HYDRATION SOVEREIGNTY EXHAUSTIVE ATTACK

records.name: Null or Primitive Snapshot Hydration Rejection
records.attackVector: Pass null snapshot to SovereignEngine.hydrate()
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Snapshot must be a non-null object.
records.details: Hydration aborted fail-closed on null input with HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION.

records.name: Negative Stat Value Snapshot Rejection
records.attackVector: Character strength stat set to negative integer (-15)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Stat 'strength' must be a finite non-negative number. Received: -15
records.details: Hydration rejected negative stat values violating the [0, 30] boundary.

records.name: Invalid stateVersion (0 or non-positive) Rejection
records.attackVector: Snapshot stateVersion set to 0
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] stateVersion must be a positive integer >= 1. Received: 0
records.details: Hydration rejected non-positive stateVersion >= 1 constraint.

records.name: Mandatory npcs Array Nullification Rejection
records.attackVector: worldInfo.npcs set to null
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] snapshot.worldInfo.npcs must be an array.
records.details: Hydration schema validation rejected missing or null npcs array.

records.name: Prototype Pollution Injection in Snapshot
records.attackVector: Inject __proto__ properties into snapshot root payload
rejectionReasons: PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_NEUTRALIZED
records.details: Global Object prototype remained clean without property pollution leaks.

records.name: Unauthorized Stat Key (godMode) Injection Rejection
records.attackVector: character.stats injected with unauthorized key "godMode"
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Unknown stat key 'godMode' in snapshot.character.stats.
records.details: Schema validator blocked unknown stat keys outside the canonical ALLOWED_STAT_KEYS set.

records.name: History Timestamp Regression Rejection
records.attackVector: History record[1].timestamp precedes record[0].timestamp
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] History timestamp regression at index 1: '2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' precedes '2026-08-30T00:00:00.000Z'.
records.details: Hydration aborted fail-closed on temporal timestamp regression.

records.name: History Turn Regression Rejection
records.attackVector: History record[1].turn (3) precedes record[0].turn (5)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] History turn regression at index 1: turn 3 precedes turn 5.
records.details: Hydration rejected non-monotonic turn regression.

records.name: History stateVersion Regression Rejection
records.attackVector: History record[1].stateVersionAfterCommit (4) precedes record[0] (10)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] History stateVersion regression at index 1: version 4 precedes version 10.
records.details: Hydration rejected history stateVersion regression.

records.name: Corrupted Negative stateVersion in History Record
records.attackVector: History record contains negative stateVersionAfterCommit (-5)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] History stateVersion regression at index 1: version -5 precedes version 2.
records.details: Integrity check rejected negative version progression.

records.name: Multi-Action Batch Sharing Same eventId & stateVersion Allowed
records.attackVector: Multi-action batch from single atomic proposal sharing eventId
records.details: Atomic multi-action batch successfully hydrated with identical stateVersion and eventId.

records.name: Snapshot stateVersion Preceding History Version Rejection
records.attackVector: Snapshot stateVersion (2) < History lastRecord version (3)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] Snapshot stateVersion (2) precedes last history version (3).
records.details: Snapshot stateVersion cannot precede historical commit version.

records.name: Snapshot Turn Preceding History Turn Rejection
records.attackVector: Snapshot turn (1) < History lastRecord turn (2)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] Snapshot turn (1) precedes last history turn (2).
records.details: Snapshot turn cannot precede historical record turn.

records.name: Snapshot lastCommittedEventId Provenance Mismatch Rejection
records.attackVector: Snapshot lastCommittedEventId (evt-forged-999) does not match history eventId (evt-init-02)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] Snapshot lastCommittedEventId 'evt-forged-999' does not match last history eventId 'evt-init-02'.
records.details: Integrity gate rejected mismatched event provenance.

records.name: Cross-Session Splicing Attack (Foreign History Injection)
records.attackVector: Combine snapshot (v=3, turn=2) with foreign history (v=10, turn=5)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION] Snapshot stateVersion (3) precedes last history version (10).
records.details: Hydration aborted on cross-session version & event incoherence.

records.name: Genesis Clean Baseline Hydration Allowed
records.attackVector: Genesis snapshot with empty history array
records.details: Genesis state (v=1, turn=1, null eventId) cleanly initialized.

records.name: History-Driven Registry Restoration
records.attackVector: Hydrate with empty executedRequestIds to verify self-indexing from history
records.details: Engine self-indexes executedRequestIds and recordedEventIds from history records.

records.name: Property Getter Trap Object Neutralization

rejectionReasons: PROPERTY_TRAP_SAFELY_EVALUATED_AND_ISOLATED
records.details: Snapshot deepClone evaluated properties cleanly without breaking engine invariants.

records.name: JSON Round-Trip Serialization & Hydration Invariance
records.attackVector: Serialize engine state to JSON string and hydrate new instance

records.name: Malformed JSON Save File Parse Failure Fail-Closed
records.attackVector: Attempt deserialization of truncated/malformed JSON string
rejectionReasons: Unterminated string in JSON at position 68 (line 1 column 69)
records.details: Parser raised SyntaxError fail-closed preventing execution on corrupted payload.

records.name: Negative Turn Invariant Violation Rejection
records.attackVector: Snapshot turn set to negative integer (-1)
rejectionReasons: [HYDRATION_SCHEMA_VIOLATION] Cannot hydrate invalid canonical snapshot: [SCHEMA_VIOLATION] turn must be a non-negative integer >= 0. Received: -1
records.details: Schema validator rejected non-negative integer >= 0 turn invariant.

records.name: High-Volume String Payload Hydration Handling
records.attackVector: 50KB character name string payload in snapshot
rejectionReasons: HIGH_VOLUME_STRING_SAFELY_CONTAINED
records.details: Engine safely contained high-volume string without memory or type corruption.

records.name: LocalStorage Corrupted Storage Fallback Protection

records.name: Cloud Save Payload Schema Conformance

records.name: Server API Pipeline EngineState Hydration Verification

records.details: Server request handler cleanly hydrates state and historical registries.

records.details: ImmigrationGate and Commit Gate enforced immutable protagonist name post-hydration.
